description.value: Bonus to Perception checks to Seek hidden doors, tunnels, or passages in cramped or underground spaces, and to notice ambushes set in tight quarters.

cinderfall.incomplete: 'Bonus to Perception checks to Seek hidden doors, tunnels, or passages... and to notice ambushes' states no numeric value. The card states a bonus/effect but gives no numeric value or formula to build a rule element from without inventing one.
